Information and Data

How can data support decision-making?

Short Answer

Use relevant, reliable data alongside context and professional judgement. Make limitations clear and protect information when sharing findings.

Detailed Guidance

Start with the decision you need to make and identify the data that is relevant to it. Check the data's quality, coverage and limitations, interpret it in context, and explain uncertainty so decision-makers can combine evidence with professional judgement.
